title: Understanding Non-Response Bias
text: Non-response bias occurs when the individuals who do not respond to a survey differ in significant ways from those who do respond. Consider whether offering an incentive like extra credit completely eliminates this issue.

hintAnswer: Incentives can increase participation but may not eliminate $$non-response$$ bias.
title: Evaluating the Impact of Incentives
text: Which of the following statements is true about the effect of incentives on survey participation?
choices: Incentives can increase participation but may not eliminate $$non-response$$ bias.
Incentives have no effect on survey participation.

title: Considering the Sample Population
text: Think about the group of students who might be more inclined to participate in the survey due to the incentive. Are they representative of the entire student body?

hintAnswer: The sample may not be representative of the entire student body.
title: Analyzing Representativeness
text: Which of the following best describes the potential issue with the sample population?
choices: The sample is representative of the entire student body.
The sample may not be representative of the entire student body.
The sample is biased towards students who do not use public transportation.
